incident.failure_signature: ValueError: HIP-3 profit-lock source omitted the latest completed minute
incident.root_cause: A temporarily lagging public 1m candle response was classified as a fatal schema error. Three immediate child restarts observed the same lag and exhausted the SPCX restart budget, after which pair shutdown sent SIGTERM to SP500.

repair.behavior: Classify a schema-valid response that lacks only the latest completed minute as TransientCohortMarketDataError. The observer publishes degraded_transient and retries without process exit, cursor advancement, candle fabrication, or decision publication.

confidence.basis: Durable fault status, four identical tracebacks, intact cursors/journals, red-green regression, focused integration tests, and post-restart process/status checks.
confidence.limits: The exact upstream reason for the transient candle omission is not known; recovery proves local tolerance, not venue availability guarantees.

falsifiers: Either observer exits again on a schema-valid latest-minute omission.
A retry advances the cursor or publishes a decision before the missing completed candle is available.
The journals cease to be append-only or a retroactive decision is marked prospective.
V57 runtime identity or authority changes as a consequence of this repair.
